title: Package Session Briefing
description: What the athlete is shown before a session of one methodology: which earlier sessions count as the same one, which numbers lead, how much history is listed and which suggestions apply. A package ships this file beside its philosophy.yaml; anything its entries do not cover falls to the default entries (src/briefing_spec.py), which is all a package without the file gets. Entries are tried in order and the first whose scope holds for an exercise of the session decides. This schema checks the shape; tools/check_provenance.py checks that the scoped ids are the package's. src/briefing.py builds the document, and the clients only lay it out.

id.description: Must equal the package directory name and the philosophy id.

scope.description: Every key given must hold; an entry without a scope takes whatever reaches it.

progression_models.description: The model that wrote the exercise's load: a training contract module's, else the modality's.

modules.description: Training contract module ids of the package.

archetypes.description: The session's archetype, or the named workout of a templated day.

named_workout.description: true: only sessions a week template composed from named workouts.

scored.description: true: only a slot that tests a standard.

same_as.description: What an earlier occurrence is: the same contract module (and variant), the same named workout or archetype, or the same exercise wherever it was done.

show.description: The numbers that word today's prescription and each earlier one, in order.

chart.description: The one number a client may draw across the occurrences.

cycle.description: Say where the session stands in its module's cycle (a density or timed cycle).

suggest.description: Suggestions tried in order; the first that has something to say is shown. Advice only: nothing here changes the program.

notes.description: The method's own words about this kind of session, shown under the item.
